Keywords: hero, hero-statement, typographic hero, headline, above the fold, opening, masthead
Purpose: Say what this is and for whom in one screen without scrolling
Content Slots: eyebrow, h1 (6-12 words), subhead (15-25 words), primary CTA, secondary CTA, trust line, ambient media
Layout: Single column on mobile; asymmetric 7/5 split or centred stack above 1024; full-viewport only when the content genuinely fills it
Motion Recipe: hero-stagger-in with immediate end state under reduced motion
Required States: default, slow-connection (text visible before media), reduced-motion
Accessibility Notes: h1 is the only h1 on the page; CTA is a real link or button with an accessible name; ambient video is muted, aria-hidden and has a poster
Common Failure: Hero copy hidden behind a JS reveal so it is blank on slow connections
Copy Rule: State the specific offer and audience. No 'Welcome to', no 'We are passionate about', no adjective stack without a noun

Keywords: hero product, product hero, bottle, can, device, packshot, product-forward
Purpose: Make the physical object the argument
Content Slots: h1, one-line positioning, product visual or canvas, variant selector, primary CTA, provenance line
Layout: Product centred with copy above and below on mobile; product right or centre with copy left on desktop; keep the product optically centred not mathematically
Motion Recipe: parallax-product-float or webgl-hero-orbit with static poster fallback
Accessibility Notes: Canvas is aria-hidden with the product described in text; variant selector is a radio group with visible labels not colour-only swatches
Common Failure: 3D in the initial chunk so first paint waits on the model
Copy Rule: Name the product and what it tastes/feels/does like. Describe the object, do not narrate the brand's feelings about it

Keywords: hero place, atmosphere, venue, property, campus, immersive hero, event hero, cinematic
Purpose: Transport the visitor into the space or occasion
Content Slots: h1, place or date line, one-line promise, primary CTA, wide photograph or video, location and hours summary
Layout: Full-bleed media with a legible overlay panel; never centre long copy over a busy image
Motion Recipe: ken-burns-slow or image-parallax-scrub with a static frame under reduced motion
Required States: default, image-loading (blurred placeholder of correct aspect ratio), reduced-motion, video-unsupported
Accessibility Notes: Contrast of overlay text against the darkest and lightest region of the image; captions for any spoken audio
Common Failure: Layout shift when the hero image loads because no aspect ratio was reserved
Copy Rule: Anchor in place and time. Give the city, the date, or the neighbourhood in the first two lines

Keywords: credential strip, trust bar, logos, accreditation, affiliation, social proof strip, as seen in, memberships, integrations, integration logos, partners, sponsors, backers
Purpose: Compress verifiable third-party credibility into one glanceable band
Content Slots: 3-8 credential items: institution, qualification, membership or client logo, each with a year or context
Layout: Horizontal row above 768 wrapping to a two-column grid on mobile; marquee only when items exceed the row and the marquee is pausable
Motion Recipe: marquee-pausable or fade-in-stagger; static row under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Logos need meaningful alt text; a pausable marquee needs a visible pause control and must not auto-scroll under reduced motion
Common Failure: Grey unlabelled logos that a visitor cannot identify and that assert a relationship that does not exist
Copy Rule: Every item must be independently verifiable. Include the issuing body and year. Never display a logo without permission

Keywords: services, specialties, capabilities, flavours, products, programmes, amenities, treatments, what we do, grid, conditions treated, conditions, ailments, procedures list, facilities, technology, equipment, flavour, lineup, rooms, suites, key benefits, benefits, project highlights, highlights, ways to help, ways to give, product or capability
Purpose: Show the full span of what is offered so the visitor finds themselves
Content Slots: section h2, intro line, 3-12 cards each with icon or image, title, 1-2 line description, optional link
Layout: 2 columns at 768, 3 at 1024, 4 only when card content is short; equal card heights via grid not fixed pixel heights
Motion Recipe: card-reveal-stagger with 60-80ms offset; cards visible immediately under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Each card is one link or has one link; do not nest interactive elements; icons are aria-hidden with the title carrying meaning
Common Failure: Twelve identical cards with no hierarchy so nothing is chosen
Copy Rule: Lead each card with the visitor's problem, not the internal service name. One sentence, no marketing adjectives

Keywords: detail, deep dive, procedure, case study, how it is made, craft process, feature detail, methodology, procedures, treatment detail, ingredient story, provenance, materials, sourcing, what is coming, teaser, preview
Purpose: Prove depth on the two or three offerings that actually convert
Content Slots: h2, narrative body (120-250 words), supporting image or diagram, bullet specifics, related CTA
Layout: Alternating text/media rows above 1024; stacked with media first on mobile; cap measure at 65-75 characters
Motion Recipe: scroll-reveal-alternating or pinned-scrub for a genuine step sequence
Accessibility Notes: Diagrams need a text equivalent; alternating layouts must keep DOM order matching reading order, not rely on visual reordering
Common Failure: Visual order reversed with CSS so keyboard and screen-reader order becomes nonsense
Copy Rule: Explain the mechanism in the visitor's vocabulary. Specifics beat superlatives: name the equipment, the duration, the material

Keywords: how it works, process, steps, what to expect, visit process, admissions process, journey, timeline of a visit
Purpose: Remove uncertainty about what happens after the visitor acts
Content Slots: h2, 3-5 numbered steps each with title, one-line description, duration or cost note where known
Layout: Vertical list with a connector line on mobile; horizontal or diagonal stepper above 1024
Motion Recipe: step-line-draw-scrub or sequential-reveal; full list shown under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Use an ordered list; the connector is decorative and aria-hidden; step numbers must be in the text not only in a background image
Common Failure: Steps that describe internal workflow instead of the visitor's experience
Copy Rule: Write from the visitor's point of view: 'You arrive', 'We test', 'You get results in 24 hours'. Include time and cost honesty

Keywords: numbers, stats, impact, outcomes, placements, counter, metrics, results, by the numbers
Purpose: Convert scale or outcome into a number the visitor can weigh
Content Slots: h2, 3-4 figures each with value, unit, label and a source or period note
Layout: Row of 3-4 above 768; 2x2 on mobile; number set in the display face at a size that dominates the label
Motion Recipe: count-up-once with the final value rendered in HTML and shown immediately under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Announce the final value not the animating value; wrap each figure and label in a definition-style pairing so the label is programmatically associated
Common Failure: Count-up implemented so the DOM starts at zero and stays at zero without JS
Copy Rule: Every number needs a period and a source. If the source cannot be named the number does not ship. Never round upward for effect

Keywords: timeline, heritage, since, history, milestones, experience, career, agenda, schedule, tour dates, show dates, upcoming dates, schedule of events
Purpose: Show continuity or sequence over time
Content Slots: h2, 5-12 entries each with year or time, title, one-line detail, optional image
Layout: Single vertical rail on mobile; alternating sides or horizontal scroll above 1024; horizontal scroll needs visible affordance and keyboard support
Motion Recipe: timeline-rail-scrub with entries revealed on approach; all entries visible under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Ordered list semantics; horizontal scrollers must respond to arrow keys and not trap focus; never rely on drag alone
Common Failure: Horizontal timeline that is unreachable by keyboard and invisible on mobile
Copy Rule: Each entry must be a documented event. No decorative filler years. Use the same date granularity throughout

Keywords: team, doctors, faculty, speakers, staff, panel, practitioners, who we are
Purpose: Put identifiable humans behind the promise
Content Slots: h2, 3-12 people each with photograph, name, role, one credential line, optional profile link
Layout: 3 columns at 1024 and 2 at 768; portraits at a single consistent aspect ratio and crop
Motion Recipe: card-reveal-stagger; static grid under reduced motion
Required States: default, hover, focus-visible, image-missing (initials placeholder), reduced-motion
Accessibility Notes: Portrait alt text is the person's name; role is text not an image; profile links have unique accessible names
Common Failure: Placeholder or stock faces standing in for real staff
Copy Rule: Name, role, one verifiable credential. No invented bios, no former staff, no stock photography of people who do not work here

Keywords: about, biography, founder, practitioner profile, chef story, the person, my story
Purpose: Establish the individual's authority and character in depth
Content Slots: h2, portrait, 150-300 word narrative, credential list, affiliations, languages, personal detail, CTA
Layout: Portrait and credential rail on one side; narrative on the other above 1024; portrait first on mobile
Motion Recipe: portrait-reveal plus text-fade; both static under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Portrait needs descriptive alt; credential list is a real list; avoid setting long biography text over an image
Common Failure: Third-person marketing prose that says nothing checkable
Copy Rule: Facts in the first paragraph, character in the second. Every qualification with the issuing institution and year

Keywords: gallery, photos, lookbook, campus life, interiors, screens, carousel, showreel, portfolio images, selected work, selected projects, portfolio pieces, showcase grid
Purpose: Let the visitor look for as long as they want
Content Slots: h2 or none, 6-24 images with captions, optional lightbox, optional filter
Layout: Masonry or fixed-ratio grid; horizontal filmstrip only with keyboard controls; lightbox must be a proper dialog
Motion Recipe: image-scroll-parallax at low intensity or fade-in-on-approach; no motion under reduced motion
Required States: default, image-loading, lightbox-open, lightbox-error, empty-filter, reduced-motion
Accessibility Notes: Lightbox is a modal dialog with focus trap, Escape to close, and focus return; every image has alt text or is marked decorative
Common Failure: Twenty full-resolution JPEGs loaded eagerly and destroying LCP
Copy Rule: Captions carry information the image cannot: place, date, what is shown. No caption is better than a decorative caption

Keywords: 3d, webgl, glb, gltf, product 3d, three, r3f, model viewer, rotate, explode view
Purpose: Let the visitor inspect a physical thing they cannot hold
Content Slots: h2, canvas, hotspot annotations, variant or state controls, text description of everything the model shows
Layout: Canvas at a fixed aspect ratio with controls below on mobile and beside on desktop; never full-viewport on mobile
Motion Recipe: webgl-hero-orbit or webgl-scroll-scrub; poster image under reduced motion or no-WebGL
Required States: poster, loading-progress, loaded, interacting, no-webgl, low-memory, load-error, reduced-motion
Accessibility Notes: Canvas aria-hidden with an equivalent text description adjacent, or interactive with documented keyboard controls; never the only source of a fact
Common Failure: Model in the initial bundle with no poster so the section is empty for two seconds
Copy Rule: Describe in text what the model demonstrates. The 3D is evidence, the sentence is the claim

Keywords: specifications, specs, technical, dimensions, floor plan, rates, policies, data sheet, floor plan, floor plans, layout plan, carpet area, dimensions table
Purpose: Answer the detail-oriented visitor completely in one place
Content Slots: h2, grouped rows of label and value, units, footnotes, download link for the full sheet
Layout: Definition list on mobile; two-column table above 768; group headings for more than 12 rows
Motion Recipe: none beyond a single fade; tables should not animate
Accessibility Notes: Real table semantics with scope on headers, or a description list; never a grid of divs; caption describes the table
Common Failure: A div grid that a screen reader reads as an undifferentiated word stream
Copy Rule: Exact values with units. Mark estimates as estimates. Never publish a spec that has not been measured

Keywords: comparison, versus, alternatives, plan comparison, feature matrix
Purpose: Help a visitor who is already comparing options do it fairly
Content Slots: h2, criteria rows, 2-4 columns, honest 'not included' cells, footnote on methodology
Layout: Horizontally scrollable table with a sticky first column above 768; stacked per-option cards on mobile
Motion Recipe: none; fade-in only
Accessibility Notes: Sticky column must not overlap content at 200% zoom; icons for yes/no need text alternatives, not colour alone
Common Failure: Competitor rows that are inaccurate or out of date
Copy Rule: Compare on criteria the visitor cares about, including ones where you lose. Date the comparison and name the source

Keywords: pricing, fees, plans, packages, rates, consultation fee, tuition, cost, pricing and availability, availability, rate card
Purpose: Remove price uncertainty as an objection
Content Slots: h2, 2-4 tiers with name, price, unit, inclusions, exclusions, CTA, tax and validity note
Layout: Cards side by side above 1024 and stacked on mobile with the recommended tier first on mobile
Motion Recipe: card-reveal-stagger; static under reduced motion
Required States: default, hover, focus-visible, recommended-highlight, price-unavailable, reduced-motion
Accessibility Notes: Recommended tier must be marked in text not by colour or size alone; currency and tax status in text
Common Failure: Prices displayed without currency or period so they are ambiguous
Copy Rule: Real prices with currency, tax status and validity date, or an honest range with what moves it. Never invent a price

Keywords: menu, dishes, food, drinks, wine list, courses, tasting, menu highlights, full menu, food menu, dish list, signature dishes
Purpose: Let a diner picture the meal and its cost
Content Slots: h2, category headings, items with name, description, price, dietary markers, allergen note
Layout: Two columns above 1024 with categories that do not split awkwardly; single column mobile
Motion Recipe: category-reveal-on-scroll; static under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Dietary markers need text or an accessible name not only an icon colour; price associated with its item in the DOM
Common Failure: A PDF menu as the only version so it is unreadable on phones and invisible to search
Copy Rule: Item names as written by the kitchen, honest descriptions, current prices, explicit allergen guidance

Keywords: faq, questions, objections, concerns, doubts, before you visit, common questions
Purpose: Answer the reasons a visitor would not act
Content Slots: h2, 5-10 question and answer pairs written as the visitor would ask them
Layout: Single column with a comfortable measure; accordion only above 6 items
Motion Recipe: accordion-height-transition using grid-template-rows; instant open under reduced motion
Required States: default, expanded, collapsed, focus-visible, all-expanded-for-print, reduced-motion
Accessibility Notes: Disclosure buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls; content in the DOM for search engines; heading levels inside answers stay consistent
Common Failure: Marketing questions nobody asks instead of the real objections
Copy Rule: Use the visitor's actual words. Answer in the first sentence, elaborate in the second. Each answer must survive being quoted alone

Keywords: testimonials, reviews, quotes, client feedback, field stories, what people say
Purpose: Let a comparable person vouch for the outcome
Content Slots: h2, 2-6 quotes with attributed name, role or context, date, source link where public
Layout: Two or three columns above 1024; single column carousel on mobile with keyboard controls
Motion Recipe: quote-fade-stagger; static under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Blockquote with cite; carousels need previous/next buttons, arrow-key support and no autoplay under reduced motion
Common Failure: Unattributed quotes that read as invented because they are
Copy Rule: Only real, attributed, permitted quotes. No composites. Regulated professions may be barred from testimonials entirely

Keywords: press, media, featured in, coverage, awards, recognition
Purpose: Borrow credibility from named third parties
Content Slots: h2, 3-8 items with publication, headline, date and link
Layout: Logo row or a compact list of linked headlines with dates
Motion Recipe: fade-in-stagger; static under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: External links marked in text; publication logos need alt text with the publication name
Common Failure: A 'featured in' wall linking to nothing
Copy Rule: Publication, headline, date, working link. An award needs the issuing body and year

Keywords: location, map, address, directions, hours, service area, getting here, branches, clinics, clinic locations, branches, consulting at, venue and travel, getting there, find us
Purpose: Get a physical visitor to the door at a time you are open
Content Slots: h2, address, hours by day, phone, directions link, map, parking and access notes, per-branch tabs when multiple
Layout: Address and hours as text beside the map above 1024; text first and map second on mobile
Motion Recipe: none; the map must not animate on scroll
Required States: default, map-blocked (consent or ad-blocker), map-loading, closed-now, holiday-hours
Accessibility Notes: Hours as a real table or list; map iframe needs a title and a text address fallback; never make the address image-only
Common Failure: Map iframe as the only address source so it fails without third-party consent
Copy Rule: Verified street address, verified hours including exceptions, an international-format phone number, plain-language access notes

Keywords: contact, book, enquire, apply, register, donate, download, waitlist, cta, get in touch, contact action, footer action, reservation action, enquiry action, cta action, book a table, get a quote
Purpose: Convert intent into one unambiguous action
Content Slots: h2, one-line reassurance, primary action, alternate channels, response-time promise, privacy note
Layout: Wide band with the action centred or a two-column layout with reassurance beside the control
Motion Recipe: cta-emphasis-on-approach at low intensity; static under reduced motion
Required States: default, hover, focus-visible, submitting, success, failure-with-recovery, offline, rate-limited, reduced-motion
Accessibility Notes: Form fields have persistent visible labels; errors are associated via aria-describedby and announced; success is announced in a live region; touch targets at least 44px
Common Failure: A form whose failure state loses the visitor's message
Copy Rule: One primary action with one wording used everywhere. State the response time you can actually meet and what happens to the data

Keywords: sticky cta, floating button, mobile call bar, whatsapp button, persistent bar, floating action bar
Purpose: Keep the primary action reachable during a long scroll
Content Slots: one action label, optional secondary icon action, dismiss control
Layout: Fixed bottom bar on mobile appearing after the hero; inline header CTA on desktop
Motion Recipe: slide-in-after-hero; visible immediately without animation under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Must not cover content: add matching bottom padding to the page; dismissible; focus order stays logical; never overlap the footer action
Common Failure: A floating bar that permanently covers the last line of the page and cannot be dismissed
Copy Rule: Same verb as the main CTA. Never a different offer from the one above

Keywords: navigation, header, navbar, anchors, sticky header, nav menu, mobile menu, site nav
Purpose: Let the visitor jump to the section that answers their question
Content Slots: logo or wordmark, 3-6 anchor links, one CTA, mobile menu
Layout: Anchor row above 1024; disclosure menu below; sticky with a compact state after scroll
Motion Recipe: header-compact-on-scroll; instant state change under reduced motion
Required States: default, scrolled-compact, menu-open, current-section, focus-visible, reduced-motion
Accessibility Notes: nav landmark; skip link to main content as the first focusable element; mobile menu traps focus while open and returns focus on close; current section marked with aria-current
Common Failure: Anchor links that land under the sticky header because scroll-margin-top was never set
Copy Rule: Label sections by what the visitor wants, not by internal naming. Six items maximum

Keywords: footer, site footer, contact footer, colophon, legal links
Purpose: Close with contact facts and the legal surface
Content Slots: contact block, address, hours, secondary links, social links, legal links, copyright, credits
Layout: Three or four columns above 1024 collapsing to a stack; contact block first on mobile
Motion Recipe: none
Accessibility Notes: contentinfo landmark; social icon links need accessible names; do not hide legal links behind an accordion on mobile
Common Failure: A footer that repeats navigation but omits the phone number and address
Copy Rule: Address, phone, email and hours in text. Copyright year generated, not hard-coded. Credits where assets require attribution

Keywords: legal, approvals, registration, disclaimer, privacy, transparency, financials, licence, privacy promise, data promise, how we use your data
Purpose: Disclose what the visitor or the regulator is entitled to see
Content Slots: h2, registration or approval numbers, disclaimers, policy links, document downloads with dates
Layout: Compact list or table; deliberately plain
Motion Recipe: none
Accessibility Notes: Readable contrast — never grey-on-grey fine print; documents state format and size; disclaimers are not hidden behind a hover
Common Failure: Legal text set at 11px in low contrast so it is technically present and practically invisible
Copy Rule: Exact registration numbers and issuing authorities. Never draft a legal claim on the client's behalf without their review

Keywords: stockist, where to buy, retailers, distributors, availability, store locator
Purpose: Send the visitor to a place that actually has the product
Content Slots: h2, searchable list by city or region, store name, address, phone, map link, online retailer links
Layout: Filterable list with region grouping; simple text list beats an unnecessary map widget
Motion Recipe: list-filter-fade; instant filtering under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Filter is a labelled control; results count announced in a live region; no-results state suggests the next step
Common Failure: A map widget that fails without third-party scripts and leaves no list behind
Copy Rule: Only stockists confirmed to carry the product. Include the date the list was last verified

Keywords: video, audio, player, spotify, youtube, showreel, podcast, release, writing, talks, articles, speaking, publications, essays
Purpose: Deliver the media without paying its full performance cost up front
Content Slots: h2, poster image, play control, title, duration, transcript or caption link, platform links
Layout: Fixed aspect-ratio container reserving space before load
Motion Recipe: facade-click-to-load; no autoplay
Required States: poster (facade), loading, playing, paused, error, blocked-by-consent, reduced-motion
Accessibility Notes: Never autoplay with sound; captions for speech; player controls keyboard operable; transcript link adjacent
Common Failure: Embedding the full player iframe on load and importing 500KB of third-party script for a video most visitors never play
Copy Rule: Title, duration and what the media contains, so a visitor can decide before spending the bandwidth

Keywords: newsletter, subscribe, updates, mailing list, follow, social
Purpose: Create a low-commitment return path
Content Slots: h2, one-line value promise, email field, submit, frequency statement, privacy note, social links
Layout: Inline single-field row above 768; stacked on mobile
Motion Recipe: none beyond focus and submit feedback
Required States: default, focus-visible, invalid-email, submitting, success, duplicate, failure, rate-limited
Accessibility Notes: Visible label or a clearly associated one; error text linked via aria-describedby; success announced; never label-by-placeholder
Common Failure: A subscribe box with no statement of what is sent or how often
Copy Rule: Say what arrives and how often. No pre-ticked consent. Provide a real unsubscribe path

Keywords: problem, why now, the challenge, agitation, our approach, mission, context
Purpose: Make the visitor recognise their situation before you offer anything
Content Slots: h2, 60-140 words of specific situation, one supporting figure with source, transition line to the solution
Layout: Narrow measure centred or offset; deliberately quiet after a loud hero
Motion Recipe: text-line-reveal at low intensity; static under reduced motion
Accessibility Notes: Keep the measure at 65-75 characters; do not set this over a photograph
Common Failure: Generic industry filler that could appear on any competitor's site
Copy Rule: Describe a situation the visitor has actually experienced, in concrete detail. No manufactured fear, no unsourced statistics
